errors: Line 63: 'المسافة بين مراكز الخلايا المتجاورة تساوي $D$' is wrong. $D$ is the co-channel reuse distance between the centres of co-channel cells. Adjacent cell centres are $\sqrt{3}R \approx 1.732R$ apart. This also contradicts line 66, where $D = \sqrt{3N}R$.

Lines 82 and 111: the answer calls the all-at-$D$ approximation 'أسوأ حالات التداخل' and says 'في أسوأ الأحوال'. That is mislabelled. Putting all six interferers at $D$ is the standard first-order approximation (Rappaport), and it gives 73.5 (18.66 dB). The true cell-edge worst case is lower. Lee's geometry ($D-R$, $D-R$, $D$, $D$, $D+R$, $D+R$) gives SIR $\approx 53.4$ (17.27 dB). The pessimistic bound with all six at $D-R$ gives $(\sqrt{21}-1)^4/6 \approx 27.5$ (14.39 dB). The answer presents 18.66 dB as the worst case and never mentions either lower figure.

Line 43: in 4G/5G the measurement reports and the handover decision do not go to the MME/AMF. LTE handover is decided by the serving eNB via RRC/X2, and 5G handover by the gNB via Xn. The MME and AMF are core-network nodes that take part only in path switching or S1/N2-based handover.
Line 41: SINR is described as 'نسبة الإشارة إلى الضوضاء'. SINR is the signal-to-interference-plus-noise ratio, not SNR.

Line 51: soft handover combining is described as happening only in the Downlink. In UMTS, the downlink uses MRC at the UE rake receiver, and the uplink uses selection combining at the RNC (MRC at the Node B for softer handover).
Line 44: the stray Spanish word 'evitar' ('ل evitar الـ Ping-pong effect') is corrupted text.
Line 65: 'بالمعноى' contains Cyrillic characters (corrupted text for 'بالمعنى').
Line 113: stray '[[SIM:signals]]' tag. An irrelevant signals simulation is attached to a cellular-geometry question.

Sanity gaps: the answer has no explicit check that SIR is dimensionless (the $P_t$ terms cancel). It does not discuss neglecting the second-tier interferers or the approximation $D \gg R$. It does not compare the result with the 18 dB AMPS design threshold, and it does not check how SIR scales with $N$ or $n$.
summary: The core derivation is correct and matches the textbook. With $D/R=\sqrt{3N}=\sqrt{21}\approx4.583$, $\mathrm{SIR}=(\sqrt{21})^4/6=441/6=73.5\approx18.66$ dB, and I re-computed every number. The handover explanation covers the measurement, decision and execution phases, hysteresis, and hard/soft/softer handover. Its weaknesses: it defines $D$ as the adjacent-cell spacing, and it calls the all-at-$D$ approximation the 'worst case' when the true edge worst case is about 17.3 dB (Lee) or 14.4 dB (all at $D-R$). It also puts LTE/NR handover decisions in the MME/AMF and confuses SINR with SNR. It has corrupted text (a Spanish 'evitar', Cyrillic characters) and an irrelevant SIM tag, and it does almost no sanity or limiting-case checking. All LaTeX parses cleanly.
